## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or gap in learning? Please explain.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision the feature working, including user flow or architectural design.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Security Considerations
Does this feature impact authentication, container network isolation, or access control?
